note: What a server returns for a view report, naming the report it answers.

fields.name: syncId
fields.note: The name the report carried. A client takes a value only 1 to 127 ahead of the last it took, counting a value below the last as 255 more, so after 255 it ignores 0. It sends its latest report again until the value it takes is that report's.

revisions.note: A client ignores the header.

fields.name: syncId
fields.note: The name the report carried. A client sends the report again until this comes back. It takes a value only where it is newer than the last it took, counting with wrap within 128 steps, and ignores any other.

revisions.note: A server names in the header the champion of the player it is sent to.
